Overview

Koforidua is a city in Eastern with a population of 130,000. The capital of the Eastern Region, a commercial hub known for its rubber plantations and the Koforidua Market. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
